description: This file defines the Download controller class within the OpenCart admin interface. It manages CRUD operations, listing, report viewing, file uploads, downloads, and autocomplete features for downloadable items in the catalog. The class interacts with models, views, and other controllers to serve administrative functions related to downloadable products.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Controller class for managing downloadable products in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main download management page with breadcrumbs, action links, and included sub-controllers like getList, header, column_left, and footer.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Loads the download list view or data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of downloads with pagination and sorting, returning the view as a string.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a download, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing download, performing validation and then calling model methods.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected downloads after permission and product association checks.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates report data for a specific download including IP, store, country, and customer info.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading a file for download with validation of file type, size, and error handling.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Serves the download file to the user or renders a not found page if the file does not exist.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides a JSON list of downloads matching a filter for autocomplete functionality.
